items.title: Akiyoshi Toshiko — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The second sister‟s name is Miyoko, who is alive and well, we are very close.

ctx.x: My oldest sister‟s name is Hisako [spells it]. The second sister‟s name is Miyoko, who is alive and well, we are very close. And the third sister, it was interesting: my father, like any other Japanese father, uh, man, they always wanted to have a boy. So they got a girl, the next one was a girl, then the third one was also a girl, so he was hoping, he said, “Well, this will be the zero for the girl,” so he named her Reiko. Rei is like another word of saying “zero.” So, then here came [chuckles], here I come…
